text: Machine learning allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, we give the computer training data that includes correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. This model learns patterns and rules from the examples. Later, we can give the model new information, and it makes predictions based on what it learned. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. The accuracy of these predictions shows how well the model works. Better training data usually leads to more accurate predictions.
